headline: Rivian sets Q3 sales record on strength of the R2
summary: Rivian set a new quarterly sales record, with deliveries up roughly 45% year-over-year on the strength of its R2 model. The Verge reports the company produced 19,751 vehicles and delivered 19,248, an 85% year-over-year jump in production.

claims.statement: Rivian set a new Q3 sales record, with deliveries up roughly 45% year-over-year, driven by the R2.

sources.quote: Rivian’s R2 just helped it set a new sales record
Deliveries jumped roughly 45% compared to the same quarter last year, with Rivian delivering more than 19,000 EVs.

claims.statement: Rivian reported 19,751 vehicles produced and 19,248 delivered, an 85% year-over-year increase in production.

sources.quote: The company released its third-quarter production and delivery numbers today, reporting 19,751 vehicles produced and 19,248 delivered. That represents an 85 percent year-over-year increase in production and a 45 percent jump in deliveries.
